title: Hilbert-Scale Stability of Posterior Diffusion Priors for Ill-Posed Signal Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2610.27030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Indirect and noisy observations are difficult to invert when the forward operator smooths out the unknown signal. In this case, the unstable modes are precisely the modes that the data reveals least, thus the success of any reconstruction method depends on how prior information interacts with the geometry of the operator across regularity scales. Diffusion priors have become ubiquitous for such problems; however, the current theory still does not determine when a learned score remains informative under ill-posed forward operators. In this paper, we study posterior diffusion for linear inverse problems on Hilbert scales and derive a stability theory under an explicit score-amplification condition. Under a smoothing condition on the forward map, a source condition on the truth, and weak-norm control of score error, we derive non-asymptotic recovery bounds in \(\Hs^s\) that separate observation noise, score approximation, and reverse-time d

translated_title: 希尔伯特尺度上后验扩散先验用于不适定信号恢复的稳定性
translated_abstract: 当正向算子会把未知信号平滑掉时，间接且带噪声的观测难以被反演。在这种情况下，不稳定的模态恰恰是数据揭示信息最少的模态，因此任何重构方法的成功都取决于先验信息与算子几何结构在不同正则性尺度上的相互作用方式。扩散先验在这类问题中已被广泛使用；然而，现有理论仍无法确定：在不适定正向算子作用下，学习到的分数函数何时仍能保持有效性。本文针对希尔伯特尺度上的线性逆问题研究后验扩散，并在一个显式的分数放大条件下推导出稳定性理论。在正向映射满足平滑条件、真值满足源条件、以及分数误差具有弱范数控制的假设下，我们推导出了希尔伯特空间 \(H^s\) 中的非渐近恢复界，该界将观测噪声、分数近似误差与反向时间（原文摘要在此处截断）的影响分离开来。
tldr: 该论文在希尔伯特尺度框架下为线性逆问题的后验扩散采样建立了稳定性理论，在正向算子平滑条件、真值源条件与分数误差弱范数控制下，证明了学习到的扩散先验在不适定信号恢复中能够给出将噪声、分数近似与反向时间效应分离的非渐近恢复保证。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a Hilbert-scale stability theory for posterior diffusion in linear inverse problems, proving that under smoothing, source, and weak-norm score error conditions, learned diffusion priors yield non-asymptotic recovery guarantees for ill-posed signal reconstruction.
